metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2025 · The Celebrity Traitors UK
metas.description: A psychological game show that follows celebrities where the contestants are trying to outwit, outplay, and outlast the challenge.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · The Odyssey
metas.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2025 · Ne Zha 2
metas.description: After a great catastrophe, the souls of Nezha and Aobing are saved, but their bodies face ruin. To give them new life, Taiyi Zhenren turns to the mystical seven-colored lotus in a daring bid to rebuild them and change their fate.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2026 · Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · De Gaulle: Résistance
metas.description: A powerful account of Charles de Gaulle's journey during World War II, from his rise as a military leader to his emergence in French politics between 1940-1945.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Dead to Rights
metas.description: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, postman A Chang posed as a photo developer, helping Japanese forces while secretly sheltering Chinese refugees. He later risked his life evacuating them and revealing evidence of the atrocities.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Ohh My Dog
metas.description: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Palestine 36
metas.description: In 1936, as Palestinian villages revolt against British colonial rule, Yusuf navigates between Jerusalem and his rural home, amidst escalating unrest and a pivotal moment for the British Empire.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Coyote vs. Acme
metas.description: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Alien: Earth
metas.description: When a mysterious space vessel crash-lands on Earth, a young woman and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
metas.description: A "Man From the Future" arrives at a diner in Los Angeles where he must recruit the precise combination of disgruntled patrons to join him on a one-night quest to save the world from the terminal threat of a rogue artificial intel...

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · The Shadow's Edge
metas.description: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · Interrogation
metas.description: When a retired judge is found dead in his house, the cops find 4 suspects who visited him on the day of the murder. Soon, each confess to their reasons for hating the man. Who is the real killer?

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · David
metas.description: From his mother's songs to his clash with Goliath, David's journey from humble shepherd to anointed king tests the limits of faith, courage, and love--culminating in a battle for the soul of a kingdom.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · 13 Days, 13 Nights
metas.description: Afghan troops guard the French embassy during the Taliban takeover of Kabul. Tasked with evacuating 500 people to the airport amid chaos, facing grave risks as they attempt a desperate escape from the falling city.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Man on Fire
metas.description: Follows John Creasy, a wounded former mercenary on a quest to get revenge for the loss of his only companion while defending the daughter of his dead colleague from the forces that tore her family apart.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · Main Actor Nahin Hoon
metas.description: A frustrated actor in Mumbai connects with a retired banker in Frankfurt through an online audition and ends up teaching him acting over video calls. Their sessions unfold across two cities, pushing both to confront buried emotions and truths they have long avoided.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Monkey in a Cage
metas.description: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · How to Make a Killing
metas.description: Disowned at birth by his obscenely wealthy family, blue-collar Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2025 · The Traitors
metas.description: A group of contestants arrive with hopes of winning a large cash prize of ₹1 crore that is built up through missions. The players are referred to as the "Innocents", but among them are the "Traitors" — a group of contestants secretly selected by the host. If the Innocents eliminate all the Traitors, they will share the prize fund. However, if any Traitors manage to make it to the end, eliminating the Innocents, they win the entire prize money.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2026 · Barreda
metas.description: In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist who brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, he ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2026 · Uyir
metas.description: SI Ajeeb, a probationary officer posted in a Kerala town, investigates the mysterious death of an unidentified woman whose decomposed body is found in a well. Despite a lack of evidence and official support, he relentlessly pursues the truth with the help of ASI Joy while battling his own psychological struggles. Inspired by true events, the film follows his quest for justice in a case that changes his life forever.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · Den of Thieves: Pantera
metas.description: Big Nick is back on the hunt in Europe and closing in on Donnie, who is embroiled in the treacherous world of diamond thieves and the infamous Panther mafia, as they plot a massive heist of the world's largest diamond exchange.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Dracula
metas.description: When a 15th-century prince denounces God after the loss of his wife he inherits an eternal curse: he becomes Dracula. Condemned to wander the centuries, he defies fate and death, guided by a single hope - to be reunited with his l...

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2026 · Awarapan 2
metas.description: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2026 · The Breadwinner
metas.description: When a supermom lands a Shark Tank deal, she switches roles with her breadwinner husband, who struggles to adapt as a stay-at-home dad to their three daughters.
